title: Nixon on whether the CIA conspired to remove him

tellings.quote: I don't know uh I know many people think so uh I would would say that I've had it found it difficult to understand why the CIA which apparently had Advanced knowledge of the break-in uh didn't inform me

plain: Richard Nixon, asked whether the CIA plotted to bring him down, said he did not know, but found it hard to understand why the CIA, "which apparently had advanced knowledge of the break-in," never warned him. The words are Nixon's own, in a clip of him played on the show, about the Watergate break-in that led to his fall. If the CIA knew in advance and said nothing, that would point to the agency letting his presidency sink.
